title: Construction Projects with Permission to Work on Weekends
what_it_is: Construction Projects with Permission to Work on Weekends

sections.label: Quieter construction permits on Sundays
sections.summary: Contractors can apply for NEA permits for quieter construction works on Sundays and public holidays, subject to conditions; 79 projects were granted permits in the Transition Phase.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Nonetheless, contractors can apply for a permit from NEA to carry out specific types of quieter construction works on Sundays and public holidays.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: These quieter works are also subject to a set of conditions, including more stringent noise limits and restricted working hours.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: In the current Transition Phase to COVID-19 Resilience, which began on 22 November 2021, 79 ongoing construction projects have been granted permits to carry out quieter construction works on Sundays and public holidays.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: In comparison, 70 such permits were granted during the preceding Stabilisation Phase from 27 September 2021 to 21 November 2021.

sections.label: Real-time video surveillance for errant contractors
sections.summary: Amendments to the Environmental Protection and Management Act require errant contractors to install real-time video surveillance, effective October this year, to enforce the no-work rule.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: Last year, in Parliament, we passed amendments to the Environmental Protection and Management Act that require errant contractors to install real-time video surveillance so that we can enforce the "no-work rule" more effectively over the public holidays as well as Sundays.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: This is something that will come into effect in October this year and will help NEA to better enforce some of the errant practices of working on a "no-work day".

sections.label: Restricted work hours and quieter works
sections.summary: On Sundays and public holidays, work hours are restricted between 10.00 am and 5.00 pm and only quieter works are allowed, with NEA continuing enforcement and monitoring.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: Today, on Sundays and public holidays, the work hours are already restricted between 10.00 am and 5.00 pm and the kind of works that are allowed are quieter works that will not cause additional noise to the residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: NEA will continue to do the enforcement and monitor to make sure that we keep the environment conducive.
